items.title: India's Solar Growth Enters a New Era

items.summary: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal concluded his official visit to the Arab Republic of Egypt from 15 to 16 November 2026. The visit marked his first bilateral visit to an African country. items.title: India and Egypt reaffirm commitment to strengthen bilateral trade, investment and industrial cooperation
